body.heading: Where in the world is Poland?
paragraphs: Poland is a country in Eastern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Poland is Warsaw.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Poland is Polish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Poland is the Polish złoty.

body.heading: How big is Poland?
paragraphs: Poland covers about 313,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of France.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Kraków survived the centuries nearly untouched — Europe's largest medieval market square, a royal castle with a dragon legend and the trumpeter of St Mary's tower.
Wieliczka is an underground city carved from salt — chapels, lakes and chandeliers, all sculpted by miners over 700 years.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Poland on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
